{{Quote|Ah, welcome back, Sergeant. Good work dealing with that ambush&mdash;I'm sure the troopers from Forty-fifth Infantry will be singing your praises for some time.|Havoc Squad Commander Harron Tavus commends a squad member on a successful mission|<ref name="The Ambush" />}}
The '''45th Infantry Division''' was a military formation in the [[Republic Army|army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] active during the [[Sith Wars/Legends|Sith Wars]] between the Republic and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==History==
In [[3673 BBY]], during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], one of the [[Division/Legends|division's]] [[Elin Garza's platoon|platoons]] was shot down during a [[Battle of Bomodon|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bomodon]]. Under the command of [[Republic Army]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Elin Garza]], and with the support of [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Marcus Trant]], the [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] fought a ten-[[Standard month|month]] [[Guerrilla warfare/Legends|guerrilla]] campaign and ultimately liberated the planet from Imperial occupation.<ref name="SWTORE" />

The 45th remained active until at least [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="3643BBY">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> when it was stationed on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] conducting operations against a [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|local separatist movement]].<ref name="The Ambush" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 45th Infantry was first mentioned in the Republic Trooper class story on Ord Mantell in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="The Ambush" />
